SYSTEMATIC_TURN_BLENDING.observation: the driven path contains ONE low-curvature segment in 41 and no separator run of any length. The plan's three corners (73.0, 30.6, 34.2 degrees) are realised as a single sustained 172.15 degree sweep over roughly 15 m.
SYSTEMATIC_TURN_BLENDING.this_is_not_route_specific: the cause is a property of how the controller realises any polyline, so routes 083 and 086 are expected to behave the same way. They are NOT attempted: trying candidates until one passes would be optional stopping.
SYSTEMATIC_TURN_BLENDING.classification: UNRESOLVED -- contributors not separated; local corner-cutting NOT excluded

candidates.CONTROLLER_SMOOTHING: pure pursuit steers toward a moving lookahead point and may never settle onto a straight leg
candidates.CONTROLLER_LOOKAHEAD: lookahead 0.45 m against legs of roughly 3.5 m; too long would cut corners, but the realised path is 0.8% LONGER than planned rather than shorter, which does not fit simple corner-cutting
candidates.ROUTE_TO_CONTROLLER_INTERFACE: the planned path is a 7-point polyline; how it is consumed may not preserve its leg structure
candidates.ROUTE_TURN_SPACING: less likely -- 3.5 m legs are long relative to the 0.29 m minimum turning radius at cruise
candidates.KINEMATIC_DRIVE_INTERACTION: the drive applies an integrated pose each step; a residual heading error would appear as continuous curvature rather than as tracking oscillation
candidates.LOCAL_CORNER_CUTTING: still possible; not isolated. Was previously and wrongly described as ruled out by total path length.

evidence_against_corner_cutting.note: total path length does not discriminate local corner-cutting

CORRECTION_20260910.what_was_overclaimed: that corner-cutting was ruled out because the realised path is 0.8% LONGER than planned
CORRECTION_20260910.why_that_was_wrong: a controller can cut corners locally while still producing a longer total path, because tracking oscillation, overshoot and curvature elsewhere add length. Total length is an aggregate and cannot isolate a local behaviour.
CORRECTION_20260910.defensible_statement: the observed total path length does not support the hypothesis that simple GLOBAL path-shortening alone explains the blending. Local corner-cutting remains possible and has not been isolated.

plan_precondition_gap.issue: the V2 PLAN precondition cannot be recomputed on the frozen 96 because the route artefact stores heading counts and turn lists but NOT the planned polylines.
plan_precondition_gap.consequence: old vs V2 planned-turn counts cannot be compared per candidate from stored evidence
plan_precondition_gap.repair: store planned polylines in future route-admission artefacts. Recomputing them now would mean re-running admission, which is a separate action and is not taken here.
plan_precondition_gap.closed_how: the polylines were not lost. The population is a seeded sampler against a fixed map, so replaying it regenerates every candidate's path exactly -- already proved for candidate 050 during collection. Recorded earlier as a gap too readily.
